hook: You might be shocked that 19 percent of replaced workers are getting asked back.

sections.voiceover: You might be shocked that 19 percent of replaced workers are getting asked back.
sections.visual_cue: A digital clock ticking backwards rapidly on a dark background.

sections.voiceover: Research polled 1000 workers in the United States. Why do they return to work?
sections.visual_cue: A professional survey document being filled out on a wooden desk.

sections.voiceover: But companies also see a 13 percent U.K. return rate.
sections.visual_cue: A map of the United Kingdom with a glowing 13 percent icon.

sections.voiceover: The 19 percent of U.S. workers demand higher pay. They also secure 33 percent transparency.
sections.visual_cue: A firm handshake between a manager and an employee in an office.

sections.voiceover: Remember the 16 percent combined return rate across both nations.
sections.visual_cue: A bar chart comparing the two nations with a 16 percent bar.
